$description: BencHUD / Eco-Comparador design tokens (W3C DTCG draft format: $value/$type/$description, string colour and dimension values, {path} aliases). Canonical values are the prototype hex values (synthesis §2). Colours with alpha are 8-digit hex (#RRGGBBAA); the original CSS is kept in $extensions.eco.css. Typography composites omit lineHeight/letterSpacing where the prototype sets none (inherit browser "normal"). $extensions.eco.source paths are relative to the Eco-Comparador planning workspace root (D:\Personal\Eco-Comparador).

decisions.CF-11: Ecopetrol highlight normalised to {chart.highlight} in PQ-only modules.
decisions.CF-28: Active sidebar item uses {brand.navActive} (#7C35EA, HTML), not {brand.primary}.
decisions.CF-43: Danger text is a single token {status.danger.text} = #9A1616; #991B1B kept only as deprecated alias.
decisions.CF-44: README dark card #24124A is conceptual and unused ({dark.card} deprecated).
decisions.CF-47: Company colour map is the PVC-based map (§2.7); served by the BFF as colorKey.
decisions.CF-61: Ecopetrol DS type scale, Tema 3 palette and Material Symbols are not adopted.
decisions.CF-71: Variation colour follows the sign of the value.
decisions.OQ-13: Colours for peers beyond the map, PTTEP magenta and the Shell chip deviation are open.
decisions.OQ-16: Breakpoints are a proposal (prototype has none).

kviMethodology.rule: Per-row resultPct = real/meta (inverted if lowerIsBetter), uncapped for display; aggregates use min(resultPct,100) weighted within category, then category weights 60/15/20/5 (reproduces 96% and 78,56%). Owned by the BFF, not CSS.

dsTypeScale.rule: Ecopetrol DS web scale (H1 48/50 … Overline 12/16) and mobile scale recorded as reference only, not adopted (CF-61).

icons.style: Custom inline 20x20 outline SVGs, stroke 1.6-1.8 ({size.stroke.icon*}), round caps and joins; no icon font, no filled icons except status dots/badges.
icons.a11y: Emoji/glyph markers get aria-hidden plus a text alternative.
